notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi! :)

I fixed a bug that would only show you newly accepted confessions when starting the game for the second time after I had approved new confessions. 

Luckily I caught this today already and it will only concern a few people. So, if you've played Confessions yesterday, started it up again today and saw the prompt "x new confessions available" before this patch was released it would be best to delete all files in this folder:

C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Roaming\Confessions

This means you will encounter some of the previously read confessions again. I apologize for the inconvenience. 

I've also added a few simple achievements for reading confessions since I figured people would be asking  for it anyways. ^^

Thank you so far to everyone who has been leaving confessions! :)

If you encounter any more bugs or have any feedback, please report it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1400700/discussions/0/2961642818638953586/]here[/url] on the Steam discussions. 

And if you like the experience, please leave a review so more people will be able to discover it. <3

Peace & Love,
Patrick

notes.title: Confessions Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi! :)

Thank you very much to everyone who has participated in the Playtest the past months. We have now gathered over 150 confessions and I think it's time to release this out into the wild!

Confessions was the logical follow-up to my first game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/758570/TOMORROW_DONT_COME__Puzzling_Depression/]TOMORROW DON'T COME[/url] (TDC) for me. After sharing my story, I now give you a platform to share yours. 

The idea for Confessions had been born about 7 years ago but all the prototypes had failed because my vision had been too complicated. Eventually I stripped the core idea of allowing players to share their stories way back to only text, which goes so well with how I went about with TDC. 

At first I wanted to release Confessions for free, but there was already a large amount of spam during the open Playtest phase, where everyone who'd stumble upon the game would get granted access. I really didn't want to imagine how much more that would be when the game is fully available since I'm moderating all new confessions. Hence I decided to go with a low price tag of $2.99.

If you encounter any bugs or have any feedback, please report it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1400700/discussions/0/2961642818638953586/]here[/url] on the Steam discussions. 

And if you like the experience, please leave a review so more people will be able to discover it. <3

Peace & Love,
Patrick

notes.title: Playtest #1 Update #1
notes.content:
First of all: thank you to everyone who has submitted one or more confessions already! If the quality keeps up being this high this is gonna be an amazing experience! :)

I fixed a few little things this morning: 

[list][*]"We hear you... start typing." can no longer be accidentally submitted as a confession.
[*]It's no longer possible to click the "next page"-button after submitting a confession without having filled up the whole page.
[*]Fixed a bug where the "submit"-button would stay grey after switching pages.
[*]Added the option to press ESC to got back to the title screen.[/list]

Out of the 150 people who have now access to the playtest, 7 confessions have been submitted. We are gonna need a lot more confessions before this can be released. So be prepared for the game to be released a bit later than December most probably. 

Peace & Love,
Patrick
